messages:
Amy (Support): customer reporting intermittent 400s from /v1/rerank, says it happens in their browser app; escalating.

Devon (Eng): can you paste the exact request body and the 400 response?

Amy (Support): customer provided HAR and a minimal repro. payload we received: 
```
{
  "requests": [
    {
      "id": "acme-req-77",
      "query": "Find overdue invoices",
      "topk": "2",
      "candidates": []
    }
  ]
}
```
and response from our API gateway: 
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "validation_error",
  "message": "requests[0].topk: expected integer, got string; requests[0].candidates: must be a non-empty array"
}
```

Jordan (API): looks like two validation failures: topk serialized as string and candidates array empty. validation returns consolidated message currently.

Maria (Support): customer claims their code uses Number(topk) and builds candidates list. they say the failure is intermittent — works sometimes, fails other times, all from same JS bundle (sdk-js v2.3.8).

Devon (Eng): possible causes: 1) client sometimes passes undefined for candidates, which JSON.stringify can omit keys or some bundlers convert to empty array in a patch step; 2) our SDK's serializer could coerce numbers to strings on certain environments (browser vs node). need to inspect what arrives at the gateway (we have HAR so we can see).

Amy (Support): HAR shows the request arriving exactly as above (topk as string, candidates empty) in error cases. customer did a console.log before sending and it showed candidates = undefined in those failing code paths. when they forced candidates = [] explicitly in their code, requests stopped failing.

Jordan (API): good repro. I'll add a small enhancement to return structured error details (field-level errors) instead of a combined freeform string so SDK teams can detect this faster. not changing strict validation — still require integer for topk and non-empty candidates. filed RL-3479.

Devon (Eng): I'll open an internal ticket for the SDK team to audit serialization in v2.3.x and add a guard to avoid coercing numbers to strings in browser builds. also add a short note in the SDK docs about ensuring candidates is non-empty for rerank requests.

Maria (Support): suggested support KB: steps for customers who see 400 on rerank: 1) check network tab / HAR to inspect payload; 2) confirm topk is an actual number (no quotes); 3) verify candidates is present and not an empty array; 4) if using sdk-js, try forcing candidates = candidates || [] and Number(topk) as a quick test.

SRE Bot: related logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/requests/2168001234

Amy (Support): customer applied the client-side fix (ensured candidates array is built on all paths and cast topk to number) and reported 200s consistently afterward. they request we keep this ticket for SDK follow-up.

Devon (Eng): noted. created backend task to improve error payloads and SDK task for serialization audit. linking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RL-3479

Amy (Support): closing the incident on our side but keeping follow-ups open. I'll post KB in support channel and ping sdk team for a patch. :white_check_mark: 

Support Bot: ticket #INC-2078 closed by Amy (Support) at 2168001800
